title: Evaluating User Experience and Data Quality in Gamified Data Collection for Appearance-Based Gaze Estimation
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not contain a benchmark that measures anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates a gamified data collection system for appearance-based gaze estimation.
findings: This paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith, and therefore, has no findings on the topic.
